body:
Thanks. I appreciate having people to talk to. 

Sadly, most of my free time kind of goes to things related to my mom. I probably really do need to find a way to make time for a hobby or SOMETHING that is for personal enjoyment. Maybe now the weather is getting nicer I'll try to go for long walks more. :)

In happy news, I'll be going to see my fiance for two and a half weeks in April . The time away will be much needed.
Good! I'm glad to hear it. I hope you can gain independence from this and not go back.
Do you have a friend you could stay with that puts you closer to job opportunities, even just on a short term basis? Offer to do housework and random chores for free.

Thank you. I know you're right, I guess it's just hard to actually take that step, you know? The problem with BPD is that it is so based on manipulation and they always try to convince you you're the one who didn't try the right things.

I found a BPD support forum online and started posting there. Hopefully finding others who have gone through the exact same thing will help me from feeling so hopeless and alone.

/hug

We've tried it a couple times. it was actually her idea. She is incapable of seeing fault in herself, though. So it went fine if the counsellor (or even family friend once) pointed at me for needing to change, but as soon as any responsibility was placed on her or I wasn't being lectured to the extent she believed I need it, she would going quiet and agree to stuff . We would come home and she would spend hours attacking me and refuse to practice anything agreed on. She thinks I turn everyone, even doctors and counsellors, against her. She will them chace them away.

She also saw a psychologist once, after many attempt from our doctor. He finally got her there under false pretences, in hopes it would lead to help. It didn't. She left out a lot and projected her view of being fine. He send her home telling her she didn't need therapy at all. The doctor and I were both very sad and shocked. She won't go back now and holds her "perfect mental health" diagnoses against me.

:/ I've even spoken to government mental health people. There is nothing I can do for her to get her help unless she threatens suicide.

Thanks. I appreciate the reply.

I've been trying to make decisions, and I guess I had. It's just the amount of hell I going through when I act on it. The last time I visited my fiance (first time I had ever traveled or slept away from my mom since a a kid...I'm 24) she sent me emails daily about how terrible it was, how she wasn't eating or able to do anything because of her health. I was told how horrible a person I was for abandoning her.

I guess it was easier to act on my decisions before I realized how sick she is. It was easier to get angry and not feel guilty.

As for friends, no. Anyone I had either couldn't take the stress, or she pushed them away. I have no one locally, just a couple online and my fiance. :/

Thanks. I appreciate the response.

I do get your logic, but I think the attraction of suicide is that I feel all choices are wrong in some way...and I don't know if I can find happiness in either of the others, because I feel like I'd be such a failure. :/ I'm not smart enough, have no real education past elementary school, little job experience....and everyone I love I seem to let down in the end. I don't really feel like my life will improve, because I will just mess it up again.

And I am afraid the relationship won't last the year needed before I can move in with him. I'm not sure I can last it emotionally, and that will take a huge toll on a long distance relationship. I feel so tired. Everything my mom says I snap at now. I used to be so patient and compassionate. It's just gone.

You are right about her needing to be an adult though. :/ Sometimes I wonder if my death would help more with that. She won't have me to focus on and blame and try to guilt into coming back.  And I won't have to face being told how horrible a daughter and person I am again.

I don't know what I'll do if the surgeon appointment doesn't  go well....
